value.rationale: The theorem determines the first two maximal values of a natural Euclidean intrinsic volume over every connected unicyclic graph on n vertices (\(n\ge5\)), with sharp unique graph types and explicit linear-in-n gap. This supplies a nontrivial graph-structural extremal classification beyond the known wedge-sum formula.
